metadata.title: PosturPro — Ergonomic chairs
metadata.description: Ergonomic chairs to care for your back. Find the perfect chair among our brands and styles.

hero.subtitle: Pre-owned Herman Miller, Steelcase and Haworth chairs, verified 100% functional and in good condition. Same design, same ergonomics — up to 60% less than buying new.
hero.imageAlt: Green high-back executive chair beside a factory-style window

brandBar.label: We work exclusively with the brands that define modern ergonomics

values.heading: Curated, not crammed
values.subcopy: No thousand-item catalogs mixing generic with premium. Just furniture from the brands that define ergonomics — selected and verified piece by piece.
values.card1Body: The same design, the same award-winning ergonomics — for a fraction of list price.
values.card2Body: We test every mechanism before selling the chair. If it isn't 100% functional, it doesn't leave our warehouse.
values.card3Body: We only select furniture in genuinely good condition — evaluated before it reaches your inventory.
values.card4Body: We never sell replicas. Every piece is authentic, with documented provenance.

process.heading: The PosturPro certification process
process.subcopy: Every chair goes through a clear process before it reaches your door — that's how we make sure it works 100%.
process.step1Body: We buy furniture from corporate liquidations and certified offices. We only accept pieces that are already in genuinely good condition — not just anything that shows up at the warehouse.
process.step2Body: We test every mechanism before accepting the piece: recline, height adjustment, tension, armrests and casters.
process.step3Body: Every chair is thoroughly cleaned and adjusted — height, tension, mechanisms — before it leaves our warehouse.
process.step4Body: A cosmetic and functional review before we assign the condition grade and certificate number.

b2b.heading: Furnish your whole office without draining the budget
b2b.subcopy: We work with HR, Administration and Facilities teams on projects from 10 to 500+ workstations.
b2b.value2: A dedicated account advisor throughout the project
b2b.value3: On-site installation, logistics and delivery included
b2b.value4: Buyback program: we'll take your current furniture as part of the payment
b2b.segmentsHeading: Types of organizations we work with
b2b.segments: Tech startups · Professional firms · Financial corporates · Educational institutions

social.heading: What our customers say
social.t1Quote: "I wanted a real Aeron, not a knockoff, for my home office. It arrived flawless and working perfectly from day one."
social.t1Attribution: Regina P. — Individual buyer, Mexico City
social.t2Quote: "We refurnished 45 workstations for our office in Monterrey. We saved more than half our budget."

calculator.heading: How much can you save?
calculator.subcopy: Pick a model and compare list price against the PosturPro price.
calculator.note: *Reference prices. Final price depends on model, configuration and the condition grade available in inventory.

trust.heading: Buy with the confidence of an established brand
trust.g1Body: Every chair is cleaned, adjusted and verified before it leaves our warehouse — ready to work from day one.
trust.g2Body: We never sell replicas or non-original parts — every piece is genuine.
trust.g3Body: We only select furniture in genuinely good condition, evaluated before it reaches your inventory.
trust.g4Body: Card, bank transfer, PayPal, and tax invoices for individuals and businesses.
trust.a1: Yes. We never sell replicas. Every chair comes from authentic corporate furniture, and its provenance is documented in the certificate that comes with your purchase.
trust.q2: What does each condition grade mean?
trust.a2: Grade A+ is practically like new, with no visible signs of use. Grade A has minimal cosmetic marks. Grade B shows visible wear but works just as well. All three grades pass the same functional check before leaving our warehouse.
trust.q3: What happens if my chair arrives with a problem?
trust.a3: Before shipping, we clean, adjust and verify that every chair works 100%, so the odds of a problem on arrival are minimal. If something's off, message us directly and we'll sort it out case by case.
trust.q4: Do you ship across all of Mexico?
trust.a4: Yes, we ship nationwide via insured courier. In the greater Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey metro areas, we offer on-site delivery and installation.

footer.blurb: Elevate your furniture, not your costs. Premium pre-owned ergonomic chairs, verified and in good condition, for individuals and businesses across Mexico.
